text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Ben Ali says his next visit to France will be to reinforce bilateral partnership and discuss regional and international issues. Ben Ali congratulates French President Jacques Chirac on French National Day.
- Tunisia beat Guinea 1-0 in an African Nations Cup qualifying match played on Sunday in Tunis.
- Foreign Affairs Minister Abderrahim Zouari held a meeting in Algeria with his Algerian counterpart Ahmed Attaf and discussed ways to reinforce cooperation in several fields.
- Good outlook for tourism sector for the southern resort of Tozeur in 1997.
